PARENT_VIDEO refers to videos uploaded by the user in Campaign Manager and is applicable to INSTREAM_VIDEO and VPAID_LINEAR_VIDEO creatives. Only PARENT_VIDEO assets can be added or removed for an INSTREAM_VIDEO or VPAID_LINEAR_VIDEO creative. PARENT_AUDIO refers to audios uploaded by the user in Campaign Manager and is applicable to INSTREAM_AUDIO creatives.
